declaration.design: Controlled fixed-5-share queue-continuation model. One neutral generation per side every10s from5..225s in every BTC5m window;5s lease, no replenishment except the explicitly tested sequential cancel/rejoin.
declaration.unit: One action row per neutral generation at a deterministic age250/1000/2000ms after activation; all scheduled generations retained as statuses. All actions within each generation share one marking horizon; portfolio arms share240s. Not a full v3 replacement.
declaration.actions: KEEP queue; CANCEL with effective latency; REJOIN same price after a modeled cancel acknowledgment plus create latency, size=client-known remaining at decision. Same unavoidable fills before cancel. All arms use the same post-only,1USD minimum notional,stale/book,gap-to-touch and Binance price guards. Maker fees must be0 in registry; no rebates. Cancel acknowledgment42ms/180ms is a declared assumption, not a measured calibration.
declaration.information: Features use cached causal Tokyo-clock market rows and last-received books. Queue features use initial displayed size, minimum observed size at this exact price, order age and notified fills, never latent simulated queue or unnotified fills.
declaration.target: Two regressions: KEEP minus CANCEL and REJOIN minus CANCEL. Cash plus inventory marked at min(decision+30s,window240s), less0.01c times change in squared terminal inventory, under neutral other-side continuation. Initial admissions are neutral; model controls continuation, not a learned entry policy.
feature_arms: market: current32 features + causal pressure changes/activity ratio + side/order price/known remaining/signed inventory
queue: market + order age/initial queue/minimum same-price queue/current same-price queue/progress
declaration.fit: Pinned pf_model_spec LightGBM parameters/300 rounds; expanding chronological train first3dates then test6. Only L50 trains; same fixed fitted models applied to M50 and L250slow. No horizon,threshold or hyperparameter search.
baselines: legacy_score at the same scheduled decisions (diagnostic, existing LODO score is not chronological)
declaration.evaluation: Neutral-action value and a separate sequential window portfolio,5shares,soft10/hard25 shares with full outstanding-size reservation,reduce-only180..240s. Report cash/marked/settlement PnL,spread and1/5/60s markouts,inventory-square time,terminal/max inventory,fill and order counts. No rebates. This controlled policy is not full v3 or live performance.

null.method: Shuffle queue-model actions within test day,side,UTC hour,minute,known-inventory sign and rejoin availability, preserving action counts. Compare its sum of neutral-action utility gains with the max across three fixed timing/queue scenarios. Exploratory, not untouched validation.

declaration.inference: Day-unit point estimates and paired day bootstrap with1000 draws,6 complete scheduled-policy test days. All dates previously consumed; no independent validation or deployment claim.
declaration.assessment: Primary comparison queue vs market-only model: common240s marked portfolio value with inventory-square time and terminal absolute inventory alongside. Improvement requires positive paired marked-value evidence and no increased inventory-square point estimate in L50, with same direction under both sensitivities; otherwise inconclusive or rejected, never deployment promotion.
declaration.controls: Positive queue-progress advantage; toxic keep; cancel-latency common fills; sequential rejoin; partial/unnotified fills; post-only refusal; bid/ask mirror; no cross-window/stale mark backfill; chronological split; bad clocks/identities/protected dates refused; independent saved-artifact arithmetic.
declaration.protections: No Oct28-30/Nov4-6/Nov9-13 quote/outcome reads. Frozen strategy/loss budget/live code unchanged. One light numeric process.

limits: Fixed scheduled5share continuation experiment, not full v3 or live implementation.
Initial placement is held fixed; no learned admission model. Queue estimates are uncertain and fill timing uncalibrated.
Legacy-score benchmark uses prior LODO scores and is not a chronological model validation.
Consumed dates only; model forecasts and bootstrap intervals are exploratory. No promotion.
